surfaceBrief.audience: Prospero users timing existing lyrics or script segments against production audio.
surfaceBrief.job: Listen, mark line boundaries, correct times and explicitly save their link.
surfaceBrief.direction: Inherit the established plum workbench, magenta actions and shared modal controls.
surfaceBrief.firstViewport: Instructions, audio and clock, marking actions, line list; save and progress remain in the shared modal footer.
surfaceBrief.signatureInteraction: Space starts successive lines and closes the preceding line; one final mark closes the last.
constraints: Retain original text and captured audio identity.
Expose incomplete bounds and review states.
Use explicit saving after manual edits or alignment preview.

breakpoints.name: timing-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Text spans the row above paired timing inputs; audio occupies its own row.

behavior.space: Armed editor only; ignores repeats and native control targets.
behavior.lineSelection: Pause, seek to known start and reset sequential remarking.
behavior.saveValidation: Skip wholly untimed rows; reject incomplete bounds, invalid ranges and overlaps.
behavior.draft: sessionStorage by context and audio ID; matching line-text signature required; cleared after successful save.
behavior.capturedContext: Audio ID and rows are captured on opening; callbacks use the captured source.

evidence.observedCorrection: Partially timed second line displays End missing in both captures.

limits: No whole-product approval or root comp-gate closure.

narrative.overview: Listen, mark, correct and explicitly save linked timings.
